processes.name: Receive a service request
processes.purpose: Turn an incoming inquiry into a complete, traceable request that is ready for an eligibility decision.

processes.name: Assess service eligibility
processes.purpose: Confirm that the client need, timing, and service criteria align before a commitment is made.

processes.name: Schedule the client kickoff
processes.purpose: Secure the right participants, time, and preparation so delivery can begin without avoidable delay.

processes.name: Deliver the client kickoff
processes.purpose: Create shared clarity on the desired outcome, working approach, responsibilities, and immediate next actions.

processes.name: Issue the first invoice
processes.purpose: Produce an accurate, timely invoice that reflects the agreed service and payment terms.

processes.name: Resolve a service breakdown
processes.purpose: Restore trust after a missed expectation while preserving what the organization learns from the breakdown.

processSteps.title: Capture the request
processSteps.instructions: Create the client record, record the source of the inquiry, and summarize the requested outcome in the client's own language.

processSteps.title: Collect required information
processSteps.instructions: Confirm contact details, timing, consent, and any documents required to evaluate the request.

processSteps.title: Prepare the eligibility handoff
processSteps.instructions: Check the request for completeness and assign it to the Program Manager with a clear decision date.

processSteps.title: Review the client need
processSteps.instructions: Compare the stated outcome, constraints, and available evidence with the service criteria.

processSteps.title: Record the eligibility decision
processSteps.instructions: Document the decision and rationale, then identify the service path or an appropriate referral.

processSteps.title: Prepare scheduling options
processSteps.instructions: Confirm required attendees and offer times that meet the promised start window.

processSteps.title: Confirm the kickoff
processSteps.instructions: Send the calendar invitation, preparation note, access details, and a clear rescheduling path.

processSteps.title: Review the operating context
processSteps.instructions: Review the request, eligibility rationale, stakeholders, constraints, and unresolved questions before the meeting.

processSteps.title: Facilitate the kickoff
processSteps.instructions: Confirm the desired outcome, roles, working norms, decision rights, milestones, and immediate actions.

processSteps.title: Record agreements and actions
processSteps.instructions: Publish the agreed outcome, owners, due dates, risks, and next checkpoint in the delivery workspace.

processSteps.title: Verify billing terms
processSteps.instructions: Confirm the legal entity, billing contact, agreed amount, tax treatment, purchase order, and payment terms.

processSteps.title: Create and issue the invoice
processSteps.instructions: Generate the invoice in Ledgerline, complete a second-person accuracy check, and send it to the billing contact.

processSteps.title: Triage the breakdown
processSteps.instructions: Record what happened, the immediate client impact, urgency, and the roles and systems involved.

processSteps.title: Stabilize the client experience
processSteps.instructions: Acknowledge the issue, agree on the immediate recovery action, and set the next update time.

processSteps.title: Capture the operational learning
processSteps.instructions: Record the contributing process, exception, dependency, or system condition and route it for follow-up.

exceptions.name: Required information is missing
exceptions.condition: The client cannot provide a required document or decision-critical detail during intake.
exceptions.response: Record what is missing, explain why it is needed, agree on a follow-up date, and keep the request in intake rather than handing it off.

exceptions.name: Urgent safeguarding concern
exceptions.condition: Information suggests an immediate safety or safeguarding risk outside the normal service assessment.
exceptions.response: Stop the standard assessment, follow the approved emergency referral guidance, and record only the minimum necessary information.

exceptions.name: No mutual availability in the promised window
exceptions.condition: Required participants cannot meet within the committed start window.
exceptions.response: Escalate the constraint to the Program Manager, offer the earliest viable time, and obtain explicit client agreement to the revised date.

exceptions.name: Delivery platform is unavailable
exceptions.condition: The delivery workspace or meeting platform is unavailable at kickoff time.
exceptions.response: Use the agreed continuity channel, capture decisions in a temporary controlled record, and reconcile them into Workboard when service returns.

exceptions.name: Tax treatment is unclear
exceptions.condition: The client claims an exemption or the agreed service has an uncertain tax treatment.
exceptions.response: Pause invoice issuance, obtain the supporting documentation, and route the case to the Finance Operations Lead for a documented decision.

exceptions.name: Purchase order arrives after service begins
exceptions.condition: The client requires a purchase order but cannot provide it before the first billable milestone.
exceptions.response: Record the client commitment date, notify the Delivery Lead of the billing risk, and hold issuance until the required reference is received.

exceptions.name: Client requests written-only communication
exceptions.condition: The client does not want a live recovery conversation.
exceptions.response: Acknowledge the preference, send a concise written recovery plan, and confirm a written checkpoint for acceptance or revision.

processDependencies.description: A complete intake triggers the eligibility decision.
The approved service path and timing constraints shape scheduling.
A confirmed meeting starts kickoff preparation and delivery.
The confirmed start and service terms provide the billing basis.
The original promise and communication history provide recovery context.
A material missed expectation during delivery can trigger service recovery.
